english.title: Fail to surrender shotgun certificate - court cancel on conviction
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the holder of a shotgun certificate which had been cancelled by **(..SPECIFY THE COURT..) Court under Section 52(1) of the Firearms Act 1968, failed to comply with a notice given under Section 52(2)(b) of the Act by the chief officer of police for **(..SPECIFY FORCE AREA BY WHICH THE CERTIFICATE WAS GRANTED..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE OF NOTICE..) requiring you to surrender the certificate within 21 days.
english.legislation: Contrary to section 52(2)(c) of and Schedule 6 to the Firearms Act 1968.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)

english.notes:
(i) See also the associated offence wording H2125 re a firearm certificate.
(ii) See Section 52(1) for conviction/order required for cancellation of certificate by the court.
(iii) See Section 52(3) re. seizure of firearm/ammunition under this Section and Section 52(4) order for disposal/destruction.
